productSpec.name: TailSnip
productSpec.thesis: Developers waste time rebuilding common Tailwind components. Need curated, copy-paste snippets that work in Cursor IDE.
productSpec.targetUser: Frontend developers using Tailwind CSS and Cursor
productSpec.mvpFeatures:
- 50+ curated component snippets
- Cursor extension with fuzzy search
- Preview before inserting
- Customization hints
productSpec.distribution: Show on GitHub, post in Cursor Discord, tweet demos

founderContext.domainExperience: Built VSCode extensions, uses Tailwind daily, contributed to open source
founderContext.existingAudience: 10K GitHub followers, 3K Twitter, newsletter with 800 subs
